{{Short description|Swiss learned society (1864–)}}

The '''Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics''' (SSES) ({{Langx|de|Schweizerische Gesellschaft für Volkswirtschaft und Statistik}} (SGVS), [[French language|French]]: ''Société suisse d'économie et de statistique'' (SSES); [[Italian language|Italian]]: ''Società svizzera di economia e di statistica'' (SSES)) is a Swiss [[learned society]] for [[economics]] and an association comprising all Swiss universities with faculties of economics,<ref>{{Cite web |date=10 June 2024 |title=Prof. Dr. Anthony Strittmatter, Full Professor of Economics, is the first representative of UniDistance Suisse to be elected to the SSES Board |url=https://unidistance.ch/en/economics/news/unidistance-suisse-in-the-board-of-the-swiss-society-for-economics-and-statistics-sses |access-date=21 November 2024 |website=UniDistance}}</ref> based in [[Zurich]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics, Zurich |url=https://www.econstor.eu/handle/10419/185863 |access-date=21 November 2024 |website=[[EconStor]]}}</ref> Kurt Schmidheiny from the [[University of Basel]] serves as the current president of the SSES.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Kurt Schmidheiny |url=https://wwz.unibas.ch/en/persons/kurt-schmidheiny/ |access-date=21 November 2024 |website=[[University of Basel]]}}</ref> The society is a member of the {{ill|Swiss Academy of Humanities and Social Sciences|de|Schweizerische Akademie der_Geistes- und Sozialwissenschaften}}.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fachgesellschaften: Sektion 5: Wirtschafts- und Rechtswissenschaften |trans-title=Professional Societies: Section 5: Economics and Law |url=https://www.sagw.ch/sagw/netzwerk/fachgesellschaften |access-date=21 November 2024 |website={{ill|Swiss Academy of Humanities and Social Sciences|de|Schweizerische Akademie der_Geistes- und Sozialwissenschaften}} |language=de}}</ref> The SSES holds an ex officio position on the executive council of the [[Verein für Socialpolitik]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Executive Council |url=https://www.socialpolitik.de/en/executive-council |access-date=21 November 2024 |website=[[Verein für Socialpolitik]]}}</ref> The society publishes the ''[[Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics]]'', an [[Open access|open-access]] [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics |url=https://www.scimagojr.com/journalsearch.php?q=21100913561&tip=sid |access-date=21 November 2024 |website=[[SCImago]]}}</ref>

== History ==
The society was founded in 1864<ref>{{Cite web |title=Éditeur Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics = Société suisse d'économie et de statistique — SGVS |url=https://reseau-mirabel.info/editeur/5718/Swiss-Society-of-Economics-and-Statistics-Societe-suisse-d-economie-et-de-statistique-SGVS |access-date=21 November 2024 |website=[[Mir@bel]] |language=fr}}</ref> as the Swiss Statistical Society ([[German language|German]]: ''Schweizerische Statistische Gesellschaft'', (''SSG'')).<ref name=":1" /> In 1937, it changed its name to the Swiss Society for Statistics and Economics ({{Langx|de|Schweizerische Gesellschaft für Statistik und Volkswirtschaft}}, (''SGSV'')).<ref>{{Cite news |date=27 June 1944 |title=Jahresversammlung der Schweiz. Gesellschaft für Volkswirtschaft und Statistik |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=DTT19440627-01.2.42 |access-date=19 November 2024 |work=[[Die Tat (Swiss newspaper)|Die Tat]] |publisher=[[Migros]] |page=7 |language=de |via=[[e-newspaperarchives.ch]]}}</ref> In 2001, the name was slightly altered to the Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics ([[German language|German]]: ''Schweizerische Gesellschaft für Volkswirtschaft und Statistik'', (''SGVS'')).<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Scheurer |first=Frédéric |date=1964 |title=Un quart de siècle d histoire de la Société suisse de Statistique et d'Economie politique 1939-1964 |trans-title=A Quarter Century of History of the Swiss Society of Statistics and Economics 1939-1964 |url=https://www.sgvs.ch/papers/1964-IV-4.pdf |access-date=17 July 2024 |website=Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{HDS|013798|Statistik|date=10 January 2013}}</ref>

The topics discussed at the annual meetings of the SSES are regularly covered in Swiss newspapers.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gr. |date=24 May 1928 |title=Das Problem der Konjunktur: Jahresversammlung der Schweizerischen Statistischen Gesellschaft |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=DBB19280524-02.2.10 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=[[Der Bund]] |language=de}}</ref> These meetings attract figures in municipal, [[Cantons of Switzerland|cantonal]], and [[federal administration of Switzerland|federal government]] in Switzerland, alongside economists and scientists from Switzerland and abroad.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=31 May 1965 |title=Konkurrenzprobleme der Gegenwart: Jahresversammlung der Gesellschaft für Volkswirtschaft und Statistik |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=NZZ19650531-03.2.36 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=[[Neue Zürcher Zeitung]] |language=de}}</ref> Past topics have included the [[Industrialisation in Switzerland|industrialisation of Switzerland]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 November 1929 |title=Die Existenzberechtigung der Industrie. |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=OIZ19291107-01.2.4 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=Die Gewerkschaft |language=de}}</ref> [[full employment]] and the [[right to work]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 June 1944 |title=Zur Vollbeschäftigungstagung in Frauenfeld |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=DTT19440629-01.2.70 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=Die Tat |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2 July 1944 |title=Fortschritte |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=DBB19440702-01.2.25.14 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=Der Bund |language=de}}</ref> [[population dynamics]] and the social position of women,<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 May 1956 |title=Gruss der schweizerischen Gesellschaft für Statistik und Volkswirtschaft |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=FZG19560512-01.2.18 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=Freiburger Nachrichten |language=de}}</ref> [[competition]],<ref name=":0" /> [[dirigisme]] and [[Regulatory economics|regulation]],<ref>{{Cite web |last=S. |first=G. |date=14 May 1982 |title=Französische Reflexionen über Dirigismus |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=NZZ19820514-01.2.23.15 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=Neue Zürcher Zeitung |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=S. |first=G. |date=15 May 1982 |title=Die Wirtschaft im Griff Leviathans |url=https://www.e-newspaperarchives.ch/?a=d&d=NZZ19820515-01.2.22.13 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=www.e-newspaperarchives.ch |publisher=Neue Zürcher Zeitung |language=de}}</ref> and the [[European debt crisis]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Blankart |first=Charles B. |date=14 June 2011 |title=Glück ist ein individuelles Gut |url=https://pressreader.com/article/282050503680611 |access-date=19 November 2024 |work=Neue Zürcher Zeitung}}</ref>

The SSES gives several annual awards,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Awards |url=https://www.sgvs.ch/awards/ |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics}}</ref> including an Economic Journalism Award for [[Journalist|journalists]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-06-23 |title=Hansueli Schöchli erhält Economic Journalism Award 2022 |url=https://www.nzz.ch/wirtschaft/nzz-wirtschaftsredaktor-hansueli-schoechli-erhaelt-den-economic-journalism-award-2022-ld.1690252 |access-date=2024-11-19 |work=Neue Zürcher Zeitung |language=de-CH |issn=0376-6829}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Wartburg |first=Reto Gysi von |date=2024-06-07 |title=SWI swissinfo.ch podcast wins Economic Journalism Award |url=https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/inside-swi/swi-swissinfo-ch-podcast-wins-economic-journalism-award/79950034 |access-date=2024-11-19 |website=SWI swissinfo.ch |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Universitätsbibliothek Wirtschaft - Schweizerisches Wirtschaftsarchiv}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=Baechtold |first=Hermann |title=Die Schweizerische statistische Gesellschaft 1864—1914 |trans-title=The Swiss Statistical Society 1864—1914 |url=https://www.sgvs.ch/papers/sjesBackIssues/1914_PDF/1914-I-25.pdf |website=sgvs.ch |language=de}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Élites suisses {{!}} Base de données des élites suisses {{!}} Société suisse de statistique et d'économie politique |url=https://www2.unil.ch/elitessuisses/entite.php?id=entite276 |access-date=6 July 2024 |website=2.unil.ch}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite journal |date=1939 |title=Schweizerische Zeitschrift für Statistik und Volkswirtschaft |journal=Schweizerische Zeitschrift für Statistik und Volkswirtschaft |volume=75 |pages=521 |via=Universität Basel.
